purpose: Test whether filtered, score-normalized v50 reranker teacher margins can safely improve a dense-only SentenceTransformer BGE-M3 checkpoint before any larger distillation.
research_refresh: SentenceTransformers supports MarginMSE teacher-score distillation, but the loss is slow and score-scale sensitive.
SentenceTransformers hard-negative utilities expose margin filters, reinforcing the decision to filter v50 rows instead of blindly using all selected hard negatives.

FlagEmbedding's BGE-M3 M3 model exposes sparse and ColBERT heads separately; after this dense-only failure, the next viable route is head-only hybrid distillation rather than more full-encoder dense fine-tuning.

training.label: tanh-scaled reranker positive-minus-negative margin
training.environment_note: The run initially failed because an earlier Deepspeed probe left deepspeed installed in the remote virtualenv; accelerate imported it and hit missing CUDA_HOME. Deepspeed was removed from the remote virtualenv and the same training command then completed.

eval_sample.sample: 200 queries / 5000 docs positive-plus-negatives sample; not comparable to full MIRACL results.

interpretation: This decisively rejects scaling dense-only full-encoder BGE-M3 MarginMSE training from v50, even after aggressive high-confidence filtering and score normalization.
The failure is consistent with v39/v40: the training target is a hybrid/reranker ordering signal, while the saved SentenceTransformer checkpoint is evaluated as dense-only.

The result does not weaken v47 or v50. It narrows the training path: preserve the BGE-M3 hybrid surface and train sparse/ColBERT heads only, or use v50 to train a separate dense student evaluated as a dense-only model from the start.
Do not publish or upload the v51 checkpoint.
next_experiment: Implement a custom BGE-M3 head-only distillation smoke: freeze the XLM-R encoder, train sparse_linear and colbert_linear against v50 target margins, load the head checkpoint into the hybrid runner, and compare against base BGE-M3 hybrid on an identical MIRACL Arabic sample before any full run.
